text:
maya (prod-marketing): Quick sync on VerdantAI case study — recording + webinar plan. We need a usable customer quote, legal clearance on the excerpt, and a webinar slot that feeds leads to Liam. Can someone own approvals?

jordan (content): I can draft the story + quote options from last week's interview notes. will drop two short quote variants for approval by EOD.

liam (AE): I'll confirm Verdant's preferred speaker(s) for the webinar and make sure their SDRs can take demo requests. also ensure we route hot leads to my queue.

zara (legal): Heads up — we need a 1-paragraph release from Verdant for attribution and product references. also checking if they need an embargo window. I can review the quote text once Jordan posts.

riley (marketing-ops): Timeline check: want recording captured this Thu, draft assets ready Mon, webinar Wed the following week. Is Thu recording still good for Verdant?

maya (prod-marketing): Thu works for Verdant (they confirmed 10–11am PT). Recording will be virtual via our Zoom. Riley — please create the calendar invite and set registration page.

campaign-bot: Zoom link created: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/verdantai-3498765432. Registration page: https://events.redwood.ai/verdantai-demo.

jordan (content): Draft quotes: 
1) "Redwood cut our latency in half and made production predictable — our engineers finally ship features without firefighting." — VerdantAI, CTO
2) "With Redwood we scaled to 3x throughput and saved 40% on inference costs while keeping quality intact." — VerdantAI, Head of ML
Posting as plain text so Legal can redline.

zara (legal): Prefer no company-specific savings numbers unless Verdant signs off. Option 1 is fine but swap "cut our latency in half" -> "significantly reduced latency". Also need the signed release: "I authorize Redwood Inference to use the above quote and company name in marketing materials."

liam (AE): I'll ask Verdant to sign the release and confirm whether they're OK with the second quote (cost numbers). Expect reply in ~2 hours.

riley (marketing-ops): When we have the signed release, can we also get a headshot + short bio for the speaker? We need those for the registration page and social posts.

maya (prod-marketing): Noted. Jordan — make two social copy options (short launch post + longer blog snippet) that fit both quote variants. Keep one version that avoids hard numbers until legal confirms.

jordan (content): Got it. Drafts will be in Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/verdantai-case.

campaign-bot: Registration form updated to collect "Company size" and "Interest: Demo / Trial / Pricing" — hot leads flagged to: liam@redwood.ai

liam (AE): Confirmed, routing set. Riley — can you add an automation to create a lead in Salesforce for any registrant who selects Demo?

riley (marketing-ops): Yes, will add SF automation after registration volume test. I'll run a test once the release is uploaded.

zara (legal): Quick reminder on IP: if Verdant contributed code snippets or internal configs in the interview, we must exclude those. Please flag any technical excerpts.

maya (prod-marketing): We won't be using code or configs. The interview was product/impact focused.

liam (AE): Verdant replied — they're OK with quote 1 (with legal edit) and will not sign off on cost percentages. They signed the release PDF and attached it here: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/verdantai-release.pdf

jordan (content): Awesome. I'll swap the text to "significantly reduced latency" and remove the percentage callout. Updated assets by 4pm.

zara (legal): Received release. All good. Minor grammar edits in the quote, but content cleared. No embargo requested.

riley (marketing-ops): Schedule update: Recording Thu 10–11am PT, editing Fri, landing page + assets go live Mon at 9am PT, webinar Wed 10am PT. Webinar registrants will get the case study PDF as a gated asset.

maya (prod-marketing): Thanks everyone. Action items: Jordan — publish drafts to Drive; Riley — calendar + SF automation; Liam — confirm speaker bio; Zara — final legal approval posted; I'll coordinate with creative for clip selection. Ping me if anything slips. :+1:

liam (AE): I'll also prepare a short demo slot for webinar attendees who want a follow-up; will block 3x 30-min slots post-webinar on my calendar.

jordan (content): Uploaded final copy + social posts: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/verdantai-final. Social short: "How VerdantAI sped up inference and shipped features faster with Redwood Inference. Join our webinar — register: https://events.redwood.ai/verdantai-demo"

zara (legal): Final note: store signed release in customer legal folder and attach to the case study before publish.

riley (marketing-ops): Test registration flow passed. Salesforce automation created; demo selections create lead with tag: "Verdant-webinar-2026".

maya (prod-marketing): Perfect. Closing thread — will post a quick playbook after launch so PMM can reuse. Thanks team. :rocket:
